messages:
emily: Quick follow-up from the all-hands finance Q&A — a few dev teams were unclear on p-card limits and capex approval flow, can someone summarize?

maria: Short version: p-card single txn limit = $2k, monthly cap per card = $5k. Purchases > $5k require a PO + finance approval. Capex (hardware, reserved infra commits) > $25k requires FP&A + exec sign-off.

jamal: Addendum: for Dedicated/reserved capacity purchases, loop in @maria and @cto_lee early. Anything > $100k in committed spend needs vendor/legal lead time — assume ~2-3 weeks for onboarding and SOW.

sam: Is there a playbook for engineers to request POs or ask for exceptions?

maria: Yes — use the procurement intake (Notion): https://notion.redwood/procure-intake. Finance triages within 48 business hours. For urgent infra emergencies use the "expedite" flag and send an email to finance@redwood.com so we can prioritize.

sara: For product forecasting, what mapping do you use for capex vs opex? Need it for next quarter's PRDs.

jamal: Mapping we use today: hardware -> CAPEX; cloud reserved commitments (prepaid >12mo) -> CAPEX; cloud on-demand/usage -> OPEX; SaaS subs -> OPEX. We'll publish the official mapping doc this week.

sam: Any special handling for software vendors that only accept card but amount > $5k?

maria: Software < $2k = p-card ok. If vendor requires card and amount > $5k, finance will either issue a virtual card with manager+finance approval or request vendor invoice routing. We prefer invoices for amounts > $5k for auditability.

cto_lee: For roadmap-driven Dedicated reservations, please include a cost estimate in the PRD and a short unit-econ spreadsheet. Tag me for anything with > $50k+/yr impact so we can weigh infra vs hosted alternatives.

emily: Can finance publish a canonical FAQ + a simple flow diagram for procurement (PO vs p-card vs invoice)? Also who does vendor onboarding contact?

maria: Action items: 1) Publish canonical FAQ + procurement flow diagram by Wed EOD. 2) Update procurement intake form to clarify expedite rules by next Mon. 3) Vendor onboarding contact: finance-ops@redwood.com.

finance-bot: New ticket created: #PROC-412 in procurement queue — https://tickets.redwood/PROC-412 (assigned to jamal).

sara: One more: p-card default limits by role? IC vs Manager vs Ops?

jamal: Defaults today: IC = $1k monthly card cap, Manager = $5k, Eng Ops = $10k. Exceptions require manager + finance approval and are temporary by default (30d) unless permanent exemption granted.

sam: Thanks. Last policy check — the AH mentioned runway target of 18 months. Is that still accurate?

maria: Yes — our planning target remains 18 months at current burn as the baseline. We plan scenario bands of 15–24 months depending on hiring and major vendor commitments. Updated slides will be shared after FP&A finalizes numbers.

emily: Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll pass this back to the eng leads. :tada:
